core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Fusun corresponds to the Persian form افسون (Persian افسون (afsūn) 'charm, enchantment, magic'). Its core sense is charm, enchantment, spell (turkish form of persian afsūn). Fusun is the Turkish form of the Persian feminine name افسون (Afsūn) 'charm, enchantment, spell'. The source gave فسون (the same word with the initial alef dropped) and the gloss 'moon, star', which is unsupported — that sense belongs to different names (e.g. Mah, Sitara). The identification as Afsun is probable.
